Pune Metro Line 3 to Commence Operations on November 3/4

Pune Metro Line 3, also referred to as the Pink Line, is scheduled to begin commercial operations on November 3 or November 4. The line will feature 23 stations according to one report, and 17 stations according to another. Fares are expected to range from Rs 12 to Rs 62.
